column2: The  general  objects  for  which  the  Corporation  is

column1: constituted are hereby declared to be—

column2: to  promote  peace  through  the  development  of
harmony among races and individuals;
to  encourage  the  followers  of  Buddhist  faith  to
secure the environment and develop the society;
to steer an individual centered society development

process  and  specially  direct 
the  Buddhist
community  to  minimize  the  problems  faced  by
children of the Buddhist faith;
to  provide  for  the  protection,  maintenance  and
development of the temple;
to provide the resident Bhikkus with security, meals
and their daily needs;
to  organize  religious  activities  in  the  temple
premises;
to  lead    the  Buddhists  both  young  and  old  to  a
religious way of life based on Buddhist ethics and
the observance of the five precepts;
to establish and maintain a Daham School, conduct
examinations, organize competitions and to provide
equipments required by the Daham school;
to establish and maintain a hospital in order to treat
devotees who face emergencies in the Sri Pada area
with the approval of the relevant authorities;
